info.title: Lyfia API
info.description:
REST API behind the site and member space of the association Une Rose Un Espoir.
The domain vocabulary (Secteur, Groupe, Journée, Passager...) is defined in CONTEXT.md.

Authentication is the OIDC session cookie set by `GET /api/auth/login`, which sends
the browser to Keycloak. Calls sent with `X-Requested-With: JavaScript` get 499 instead
of that redirect when the session is missing or expired.

Visiteurs read some resources without logging in (GET on groups, configurations,
medias, carousel, galerie, features, sectors, events and posts); every other call
requires a session, and the Role then decides what it may do.

SecurityScheme.name: q_session
SecurityScheme.description: OIDC session cookie, obtained through GET /api/auth/login (Keycloak)
